answer: The saffron holds work receipts rather than names, so the terrace of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the horizon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
